title: Gulf View Condo w/ Pool – Watersound 30A FL
meta_description: Luxurious coastal living with breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico from your large balcony. Features galore! Overlooking the large pool, steps to the beach, open concept living, fully stocked gourmet kitchen, fitness center, nearby shopping, and more!
description_expanded: AboutProperty Highlights: * Stunning gulf views from multiple windows * Balcony view of community swimming pool (seasonally heated) * Near beach access * Community fitness center and parks * Right outside Watersound’s gate, enjoy paved Timpoochee Trail * Gated 30A Watersound Community * Gorgeous coastal luxury décor * Fully stocked kitchen * Viking stainless steel appliances * Pet friendly * Three bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms * Four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella * Free wifi * Private attached garage * Close to dining, shopping, and entertainment * Home is stocked with Starbucks coffee pack, creamer, sugar, bottles of water, and a starter amenity package with a roll of paper towels, dish soap, sponge, kitchen wipes, dishwasher soap, laundry detergent pods, pillow spray, shampoo, conditioner, aloe, lotion, bathroom soaps, and a roll of toilet paper in each bathroom. Welcome to Watersound Retreat, your luxurious Gulf-front retreat in the heart of Watersound along scenic 30A. This stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath condo is a two-story haven with all the high-end touches you expect—perfect for families or groups looking to unwind in style. Located in one of 30A's most sought-after communities, Watersound is between the Gulf of Mexico’s stunning beaches, Camp Creek Lake, and Deer Lake State Park, offering unbeatable access to some of the most beautiful natural landscapes. With so much to offer, this Watersound vacation rental is the perfect place to create unforgettable 30A vacation memories. When you're ready to explore, the Watersound Beach community offers swimming pools, clubhouses, and boardwalks that lead through the dunes to the stunning beaches. On the first floor, you'll find a serene primary king suite complete with custom-built closets, a spa-like en-suite bath, and a private covered deck, ideal for enjoying a morning coffee while soaking in the coastal breeze. This level also includes a fun bunk room designed with kids in mind ensures plenty of room for everyone to relax and recharge. A spacious laundry room, a kitchenette, ample storage, and an attached garage add to the convenience, making this floor as functional as it is luxurious. Upstairs, the bright and airy living and dining areas open to a second-covered Gulf-front deck with breathtaking views of the emerald-green Gulf waters and also overlooks the community pool, providing a tranquil view. The gourmet kitchen, outfitted with Viking stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and elegant cabinetry, flows seamlessly into the entertaining space. Two additional guest bedrooms, each with a private bath, can be found on the second floor ensures plenty of room for everyone to relax and recharge. With its prime location near boutique shopping, dining, and entertainment at The Hub and easy access to the sugar-white sands of the Emerald Coast beaches, Watersound Retreat offers the perfect blend of luxury and convenience. Experience the Gulf Coast Getaway you've always dreamed of with FunVacay!
